@graph.description: Compare Help Scout Free, Standard, Plus and Pro prices, included limits, extra inbox and Docs fees, Envoy costs, and annual billing before buying.

itemListElement.name: Help Scout Pricing: Plans and AI Costs

mainEntity.name: Is Help Scout billed per agent or per ticket?

acceptedAnswer.text: The paid plans are priced per user. Envoy is billed separately by AI resolution.

mainEntity.name: Can I add more Inboxes or Docs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Additional Inboxes and Docs sites are available as paid add-ons; check the current annual or monthly price.

mainEntity.name: Does the annual plan cost less?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pricing page shows a 16% annual discount. Confirm the total and commitment before buying.
Yes. Help Scout says you can set a monthly resolution spending cap, and the agent turns off when the cap is reached for that cycle.
